source: Dex Collection distributor product pages (dexcollection.com.au, Price (AUD) tab: Local Pricing with Same Day, 24 Hours, 3, 7 and 12 Working Days tabs, each with its own Additional Decoration Costs and min/max quantity per service), all 838 Dex range products read 3 Nov 2026. Promodata repeats every branding method once per production time ('Same Day Print Per Col/Pos', '24 Hrs. Print Per Col/Pos', … '12 Days Print Per Col/Pos'); the blank price is the same for every local production time. So the customer picks a production time, and each branding method is priced from that time's line. Prices stay Promodata's (SaaS pricing). The 28-day and longer offshore lines (hidden by TOD's rule, with their own CE blank price) are not offered.
